article_manufactured_consent.summary: The most effective persuasion does not forbid opinions — it arranges the information environment so that some opinions arrive pre-made. This article examines how attention is steered in the digital age: agenda-setting, manufactured consent, soft power, self-censorship and crowd psychology, and how independent thought survives in managed information spaces.
article_manufactured_consent.title: Manufactured Consent: The Quiet End of Independent Thought
